* [[Christine Todd-Whitman]] announces that on June 27 she will resign her position as Administrator of the [[United States Environmental Protection Agency]]<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2003/05/21/politics/21WIRE-WHIT.html |title=Whitman, E.P.A. Administrator, Resigns |newspaper=New York Times |date=May 21, 2003 |accessdate=May 12, 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090423042057/http://www.nytimes.com/2003/05/21/politics/21WIRE-WHIT.html |archive-date=April 23, 2009 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* The [[Chelsea Flower Show]] opens
* A case of [[Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy|BSE]] ("mad cow disease") in a single [[cow]] in [[Alberta]] is confirmed by Canadian federal and provincial officials. The animal had been destroyed and declared unfit for consumption prior to being diagnosed. The US issues a temporary ban on all Canadian beef. This is the first North American case of BSE since one in 1993 involving an animal born in Britain.
* [[DARPA]]'s Congressional report announces that the controversial [[Information Awareness Office|Total Information Awareness]] program will be known as the [[Terrorist Information Awareness]] program from now on, to emphasize that its purpose is to compile data on terrorists, and not to compile dossiers on US citizens.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://w2.eff.org/Privacy/TIA/20030523_tia_report_review.php |title=EFF Review of May 20 Report on Total Information Awareness |access-date=2017-09-14 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160307135558/https://w2.eff.org/Privacy/TIA/20030523_tia_report_review.php |archive-date=2016-03-07 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* ''[[Buffy the Vampire Slayer (TV series)|Buffy the Vampire Slayer]]'' aired its series finale, concluding the seven year series.
* The [[Massively multiplayer online first-person shooter|massively-multiplayer online first-person-shooter]] [[video game]] [[Planetside]] released in North America.
